result.summary: The page is generally well-formed, but several horizontally scrollable elements are visibly clipped at the right edge, making the layout appear cut off rather than intentionally contained.

issues.description: The cuisine filter row is clipped on the right: a partial next category pill is visible with no clear right-side padding or scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal filter scroller has appropriate end padding and consider a fade/chevron cue so partially visible items look intentional.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' restaurant carousel is cut off at the right edge. The third card and its restaurant name are visibly truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...').
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding to the carousel and size cards so the partial next card is deliberate; avoid truncating essential restaurant names in the visible viewport.

issues.description: The next restaurant promotion card at the bottom is abruptly obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, leaving only part of the image visible.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content inset/padding so scrolling content can clear the fixed navigation bar.
